QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR GOOGLE ADS
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does Google Ads cost in Kilkenny?

Management from €1,500 a month, ad spend separate. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Kilkenny?
Yes. We work with businesses in Kilkenny and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
What budget do I need to start Google Ads?
We recommend a minimum monthly ad spend of €1,000–€2,000 for meaningful data and results. Our management fees are separate from your ad spend budget.
How long before I see results?
Google Ads can drive results from day one. Campaigns typically need 4–8 weeks to fully optimise as the algorithm gathers conversion data.
Do you manage existing accounts or start fresh?
Both. We'll audit your existing account first — often there are significant improvements to make before rebuilding from scratch.
What's included in monthly management?
Bid management, ad copy testing, keyword expansion and pruning, audience optimisation, Quality Score improvements, landing page recommendations, and a monthly performance report.
